title: Midtown Fall Aerial
summary: So much of Toronto is made up of tree-lined streets that you can be forgiven for not identifying Mount Pleasant Cemetery from the air, but that's what the colourful Fall foliage is hiding in the foreground of this shot. Behind it, the towers of Davisville Village, more low-rise streets, then the doubly-dense node of Midtown, all bathed in late day sun.
